title: kickxia spuria subsp. integrifolia
intro: Kickxia spuria subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as the entire-leaved autumn gentian, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Kickxia spuria subsp. integrifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help in soothing digestive issues, relieving pain, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
